description: Happy path: active dietary supplement (Vitamin D3 2000 IU daily) self-reported by the patient
notes: Dose and active status ride clinical:dose and clinical:isActive. These are NOT clinical:dosage and clinical:status, which are clinical:MedicationShape's predicates; SupplementShape constrains neither, so a supplement written with the medication spellings validates clean and is silently unreadable. This fixture pins the correct pair.
